Bill.BriefDescription: Directing the board of natural resources to exchange certain common school trust land.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to public lands; adding a new section to chapter43.30 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.30 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The board shall exchange common school trust land, commonly knownas the "Hats and Boots" parcel, adjoining the Duwamish training centerbranch of South Seattle Community College for land of equal valuegranted to the state for the support of charitable, educational, penal,and reformatory purposes. The state board for community and technicalcolleges shall pay one dollar per year to lease the exchanged propertyat the site commonly known as the "Hats and Boots" parcel once theexchange is completed by the board.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effect p. 1 HB 3045immediately.
